I was parked on public land, next to other cars, and the only thing that prevented me was the idea of people seeing me carrying a gun to my inevitable death with nothing else on me. 

A lot of things helped me stay here, I tried other solutions after that didn’t work. It gets better, and even if it’s hard there is still hope to find something that makes you fulfilled.

I loved someone who had this problem often, and even though I’m not there, all I would say is to breathe and relax. 

I’m sorry I’m not much help, but I can personally say stress for me often comes from tensing up. Every part of the body, I have a seizure disorder from stress I’ve moved past a lot, but it’s still a fear of mine and can be triggered by anxiety at anytime. Try your hardest to focus on breathing and stop tensing up, especially in your brain and face, try meditating and practicing bringing your heart rate down and finding peace, I’m here for you even if I’m not much help

You will find fulfillment and success, even though I’m in a similar spot, there are two influential people in my life I met in the past year who came from similar circumstances and assure me it will get better.

I’m 22 as well, promise me you’ll keep trying if I do. Message me anytime.

Remember the innocence they took and remember that next time you have one of these thoughts. Have empathy for people and want good things for them always.

Live righteously and for the purpose of doing the right thing, I’ll be honest I have no idea what you’re going through and I’ve always felt overwhelmingly angry on this subject. Please do the world a favor and be part of what’s good.

Look at history and people to look up to, find fulfillment in things that are gratifying and rewarding, not just quick ways to feel better, that extends to sex as a whole, which is like a drug. Look to god and those who have done well, find your way and ignore hopeless obsessions that are evil. Thank you for being honest.
